newsitem.title: USA: Humana sees acquisition accretive in FY98.
newsitem.headline: Humana sees acquisition accretive in FY98.

text.p: Humana Inc said Tuesday it expects the proposed acquisition of Physician Corp of America to be accretive to fiscal year 1998 earnings by between $0.08 per share and $0.10 per share.
Humana also said it did not expect to post a charge from the acquisition, according to John Sullivan, a company spokesman.
Humana, a health care services provider, said earlier it signed a definitive pact to buy Physician Corp in a deal valued at about $400 million.
Humana said it would pay $7 per share for Physician and assume about $130 million of Physician debt.
Physician Corp has health maintenance organizations in Florida, Texas and Puerto Rico.
